# Third-party assets

Every external asset lives in its own folder here, e.g. `ThirdParty/<AssetName>/`,
together with a `LICENSE.txt` or `CREDITS.md` that states the source URL, author and licence.
`tools/check_repo.py` fails when a folder here has no licence/credit file.
Keep each asset under 20 MB (GitHub LFS free quota is 1 GB); ask the team before adding a bigger one.
Credits are collected for submission in SB-61.
